_note_manuscript: The manuscript came in as Word-laid-out text (Downloads/ECE 3-4 TG ICIBEMBA - typeset corrected .docx, saved 5 Nov 2026). Its bullets and exercise numbers exist only in Word's List Bullet / List Number styles, hence styleLists.
subject: Icibemba
_note_cover: The manuscript's cover picture (image2.png, 1564x1055) is a finished mock-up with ICIBEMBA, the book-type band and the age badge baked in. Word-free crop x 116-944, y 492-1021 at the series card's shape (the teacher and the children), Real-ESRGAN x4 then 2452x1568. Nothing painted; the wall poster 'A' stays in the scene.
_note_coverWords: As the sister Icibemba ECE LB.
_note_labels: One look for each recurring label: the manuscript types them as headings, run-in leads and loose lines.
_note_signatory: Front-matter signatories alike: name bold, title and office plain.
_note_edit: Full read 2026-11-05 (user: fix everything). Keyboard slips, replace-all damage ('landa iciunda' where no sound is meant, doubled 'cikope', 'ifilefwaikwa' over the object), wrong-language words (Kinyanja), one spelling per word by the book's majority, Learner's Book -> Icitabo ca Musambi, Iciputulwa 1 -> Levo 1.
